rationale: CR-001 is resolved. The fix-up adds an executable, opt-in GitLab DiffNote scenario that submits and verifies a nested position payload, plus validation guidance; current source confirms POST/PUT/PATCH use json=method_arguments while GET and non-nested behavior remain unchanged. Runtime execution against GitLab remains Stage 7 validation.

business_review.item: GitLabTool sends JSON bodies using json=method_arguments for GitLab API requests that require JSON payloads.
business_review.notes: POST, PUT, and PATCH use requests.request(json=method_arguments).

business_review.item: Inline GitLab merge request discussions can be created successfully with a valid nested position object.
business_review.notes: Only mocked request construction is covered; successful GitLab acceptance is not demonstrated.

business_review.item: The same payload produces equivalent behavior from CodeMie Git tool and manual curl.
business_review.notes: Wire-level equivalence requires the missing inline-discussion validation.

business_review.item: No fallback to MR-level notes is needed when a valid inline discussion payload is provided.
business_review.notes: The changed tool has no fallback path, but successful end-to-end behavior is not validated.

business_review.item: Existing GitLabTool requests without nested payloads continue to work.
business_review.notes: GET query parameters, DELETE data behavior, and scalar POST behavior remain covered.

business_review.item: Regression coverage is added or updated for POST, PUT, and PATCH requests with nested JSON objects.
business_review.notes: A parameterized test covers all three methods and preserves the nested position object.

business_review.item: The fix is validated against at least one GitLab inline discussion scenario that creates a DiffNote.
business_review.notes: The reviewed diff contains neither an executable DiffNote scenario nor validation guidance.

standards_review.notes: The review-range commit subjects use the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format.
The changed Python follows the existing Ruff-oriented structure and retains Apache license headers.
The change does not add credentials, authorization parsing, sensitive logging, or lossy input handling.

finding_status.notes: Added tests/codemie_tools/core/vcs/gitlab/test_diffnote_integration.py and inline-diffnote-validation.md. The opt-in test sends a nested position payload through GitlabTool and asserts a 201 DiffNote response with matching position fields; source confirms the JSON request path.
